title: Plans and subscription
summary: Your plan decides which features you have. Free is the default and is limited; Pro has every feature except organizations; Enterprise adds organizations. Pro and Enterprise are paid subscriptions.
usage: Open Plans in the side menu (or Ctrl+K) to see what each plan includes. Subscribe opens the payment page in your browser, and the plan updates by itself when it's done. Manage subscription lets you change the card or the plan, or cancel. Prices show in your country's currency, and you can pick another on the plans page. Features your plan doesn't include show as not included.
